# 中文 (简体)

Krea 2 Turbo 文生图工作流，包含图像风格参考、可切换的单/双采样器路径、嵌入层级的种子变化，以及一个实验性的 SDE 噪声注入环节。

## 1. 所需自定义节点

| 本工作流使用的节点 | 插件包 | 仓库地址 |

|---|---|---|

|

ComfyUI 核心节点（无需安装）

> ⚠️ **关于"安装缺失节点"的提醒：** 本 JSON 中有若干节点的元数据带有错误的），ComfyUI Manager 可能因此解析到错误的插件包。若自动安装出现异常，请手动安装上表中的仓库。

### 所需模型

| 类别 | 文件 |

|---|---|

| UNET（扩散模型） |

| CLIP / 文本编码器 |—— 加载器类型设为 *krea2** |

| VAE |

| LoRA（已启用） |

任何兼容 Krea 2 的 Qwen3-VL 文本编码器均可使用，但 CLIPLoader 的 **type 必须保持krea2**。LoRA 路径指向子目录，请保持相同的目录结构，或在加载器中重新选择文件。

## 2. 使用说明

### 输入区（左侧蓝色分组）

- **节点 30**（绿色）—— **正向提示词**。自带的提示词是一段较长的描述性文字；Krea 2 对散文式描述的响应优于标签堆砌。

- **节点 34**（红色）—— **负向提示词**，默认为空。

- **节点 39**—— 输出尺寸。当前为Preset模式 →。将模式切换后可改用手动宽高输入。

### 风格参考

本工作流有**两套独立的风格控制**，可任选其一或同时使用：

1. **图像参考** ——（节点 31）同时接入两个文本编码器的image1。Ostris Krea 2 Edit 编码器会将参考图融入 conditioning，因此构图与画面质感会从源图延续过来。节点 30/34 的插槽仍空置，可叠加更多参考图。

2. **LoRA 堆叠** ——（节点 16）内含 12 个 Krea 2 风格 LoRA，默认启用两个），其余已关闭，可自行尝试。每行的开关可独立切换，强度可就地调整。

文档：https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy

若想进行不受图像影响的纯文生图，请断开或旁路节点 31。

### 采样器切换（Lazy Switch KJ）

**节点 26**决定实际执行哪条采样路径。你只需要操作那个布尔开关：

| 开关 | 路径 | 配置 |

|---|---|---|

| *false**（当前） | **单段** → 节点 37 | 8 步，denoise 1.0，CFG 1.0，随机种子 |

| *true** | **两段** → 节点 22 → 节点 36 | 第一段（节点 22）：10 步中运行 8 步，denoise 1.0 · 第二段（节点 36）：最后 2 步

"Lazy（惰性）"意味着未被选中的分支根本不会执行，因此切换开关不会在闲置路径上产生任何开销。两段式路径本质是一次精修：先用快速的 DDIM 段确定构图，再用简短的高阶 Munthe-Kaas 低 denoise 段收拾细节。

采样器文档：https://github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF· 开关文档：https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes

### 种子变化增强（节点 40）

位于正向编码器与三个采样器之间。它将结构化噪声注入**文本嵌入**而非潜空间，因此能在同一提示词下产生真正的构图多样性，同时不破坏提示词贴合度 —— 这对 Krea 2 尤其有用，因为仅更换采样种子往往几乎不改变画面。

当前设置：预设🌱 Subtle、模型类型、衰减Instant、注入、无 token 保护、无方向偏移、调度、种子随机。

- 会在时间线的**前约 20%** 施加变化 —— 构图自由发挥，细节渲染保持干净。

- 提高（Subtle → Balanced → Creative → Bold → Wild）可获得更大差异；过高会损害提示词贴合度。

- *决定强度倍率** —— 以 Z-Image 为基准Krea2为 1.2 倍强度 / 1.1 倍随机化。在完整的模型列表中这些倍率相差可达 20 倍，因此该设置对敏感模型影响极大；但在 Krea 2 上差异较小。

- 改变噪声的*性质* —— 每个选项都有各自的噪声生成器。该节点内还有一套针对 Krea2 的 12 频带整形逻辑，但其触发条件是嵌入维度能被 12 整除；本工作流使用的 Qwen3-VL 编码器维度为 2560，因此该逻辑永远不会激活。方向偏移本身仍然有效，只是不会叠加频带倍率。

- 当不起作用；它们仅在模式下生效。

文档：https://github.com/RamonGuthrie/ComfyUI-RBG-SmartSeedVariance

### 输出与后期处理

1. **节点 17**—— 分块解码（分块 1024 / 重叠 128）。保留该节点是因为在 Mac 上大尺寸解码非常吃内存；若使用大显存显卡，普通会更快。

2. **节点 23**—— 后期处理环节。色温 / 色相 / 亮度 / 对比度 / 饱和度 / 伽马，目前全部为**中性值**，因此在你调整之前它只是直通。最终调色建议在此完成，而不是写进提示词。

文档：https://github.com/sipherxyz/comfyui-art-venture

3. **节点 19**—— 滑块对比，**A = 调色后**，**B = 原始解码**，可直观看到调色带来的差异。

4. **节点 21**—— 前缀Krea2/1。请注意它在本文件中**并非**处于常规的 Always 模式，因此刚导入时不会自动保存；如需每次运行都写入磁盘，请将其设为 Always。

## 3. 节点 25 —— 实验性噪声注入

**节点 25是一项实验。** 它向全部三个 ClownsharKSampler（节点 22、36、37）输入一个OPTIONS组合，在采样器自身的eta之上叠加 SDE 式噪声 —— 在采样过程中重新掺入噪声，以强化质感与颗粒，而不是让画面平滑收敛。

当前设置：噪声类型 gaussian（主步与子步）、噪声模式hardeta0.50.5、固定种子。

**该节点完全可选。** 将其旁路Ctrl+B）后，工作流会依照采样器自身的设置正常运行，得到更干净、更平滑的结果。你可以随意调整、静音或删除它。降低 eta 可获得更细微的效果，提高则更粗粝。请把它当作一个质感调节旋钮，而非流程中的必需环节。

## 快速上手

1. 安装上表中的七个插件包，重启 ComfyUI。

2. 载入三个模型；确认 CLIPLoader 的类型为krea2。

3. 在节点 31 放入参考图（或将其旁路以进行纯文生图）。

4. 在节点 30 写入提示词。

5. 在节点 39 设置尺寸。

6. 节点 26 保持false可快速运行 8 步；切换为true则执行两段式精修。

7. 可选：旁路节点 25 以获得更干净的画面。

8. 加入队列执行。

# DnD-K2T-T2I v1.8 — "Dust and Dreams"

Krea 2 Turbo text-to-image workflow for ComfyUI, with an image style reference, a switchable single/dual sampler path, embedding-level seed variance, and an experimental SDE noise-injection stage.

---

# English

## 1. Required Custom Nodes

| Nodes used in this workflow | Package | Repository |

|---|---|---|

| TextEncodeKrea2OstrisEdit, Krea2OstrisEditModelPatch| ComfyUI-Krea2-Ostris-Edit |https://github.com/ostris/ComfyUI-Krea2-Ostris-Edit |

| ClownsharKSampler_Beta, ClownOptions_SDE_Beta| RES4LYF |https://github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF |

| LazySwitchKJ| ComfyUI-KJNodes |https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes |

| Power Lora Loader, Image Comparer, Label| rgthree-comfy |https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy |

| RBG_Smart_Seed_Variance| ComfyUI-RBG-SmartSeedVariance |https://github.com/RamonGuthrie/ComfyUI-RBG-SmartSeedVariance |

| ColorCorrect| comfyui-art-venture |https://github.com/sipherxyz/comfyui-art-venture |

| AGSoft_Empty_Latent_Krea2| comfyui-AGSoft |https://github.com/Art-xmaster/comfyui-AGSoft |

Core ComfyUI nodes (no install needed):UNETLoader, CLIPLoader, VAELoader, LoadImage, VAEDecodeTiled, SaveImage.

> ⚠️ **Heads-up on "Install Missing Nodes":** several nodes in this JSON carry an incorrectcnr_id comfyui_fearnworksnodes) in their saved metadata. ComfyUI Manager may therefore resolve them to the wrong package. If auto-install misbehaves, install the repos in the table above manually.

### Models expected

| Slot | File |

|---|---|

| UNET (diffusion model) |krea2_turbo_bf16.safetensors |

| CLIP / text encoder |qwen3VLInstruct4bHeretic_v10.safetensors— loader type set to *krea2** |

| VAE |wan_2.1_vae.safetensors |

| LoRAs (enabled) |Krea 2/style/krea2_style_reference.safetensors, Krea 2/style/Purple_Grainy_Kr2_AM.safetensors |

Any Krea 2–compatible Qwen3-VL text encoder will work; the CLIPLoader **type must staykrea2**. LoRA entries point at aKrea 2/style/subfolder — either mirror that folder layout or re-pick the files in the loader.

## 2. How to Use

### Inputs (blue group, left)

- **Node 30** (green) — your **positive prompt**. The shipped prompt is a long descriptive paragraph; Krea 2 responds well to prose rather than tag lists.

- **Node 34** (red) — **negative prompt**, empty by default.

- **Node 39**AGSoft_Empty_Latent_Krea2— output size. Set to modePreset → Landscape - 1920x1080 (16:9). Switch the mode widget to use the manual width/height fields instead.

### Style reference

This workflow has **two independent style controls** — use either or both:

1. **Image reference** —LoadImage(node 31) feedsimage1onbothtext encoders. The Ostris Krea 2 Edit encoder folds the reference image into the conditioning, so composition and look carry over from the source image. Nodes 30/34 haveimage2andimage3slots free if you want to stack more references.

2. **LoRA stack** —Power Lora Loader(node 16) holds 12 Krea 2 style LoRAs; two are on by defaultkrea2_style_reference, Purple_Grainy_Kr2_AM), the rest are toggled off and ready to experiment with. Toggle with the switch on each row and adjust strength inline.

Docs:https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy

To run pure text-to-image with no image influence, disconnect or bypass node 31.

### The sampler switch (Lazy Switch KJ)

**Node 26**LazySwitchKJpicks which sampler path actually renders. The boolean widget is the only thing you touch:

| Switch | Path | Configuration |

|---|---|---|

| *false** (current)| **Single stage** → node 37 | 8 steps,exponential/ddim + beta57, denoise 1.0, CFG 1.0, seed randomized |

| *true** | **Two stage** → node 22 → node 36 | Stage 1 (node 22): 8 of 10 steps,exponential/ddim + beta57, denoise 1.0 · Stage 2 (node 36): final 2 steps,exponential/res_4s_munthe-kaas + kl_optimal, denoise 0.27 |

"Lazy" means the unused branch is never executed — flipping the switch costs nothing on the idle path. The two-stage route is a refiner pass: a fast DDIM block lays down composition, then a short high-order Munthe-Kaas pass at low denoise cleans up detail.

Sampler docs:https://github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF· Switch docs:https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes

### Seed variance (node 40)

RBG_Smart_Seed_Variancesits between the positive encoder and all three samplers. It injects structured noise into the **text embeddings** rather than the latent, which produces genuine compositional variety from the same prompt without breaking prompt adherence — useful on Krea 2, where changing the sampler seed alone often barely moves the image.

Current settings: preset🌱 Subtle, model type📸 Krea2 (SingleStream), fadeInstant, injectionBeginning Steps, no token protection, no direction shift, scheduleconstant, seed randomized.

- Beginning Stepsapplies the variance over roughly the **first 20%** of the timeline — composition roams, detail rendering stays clean.

- Raisevariance_preset(Subtle → Balanced → Creative → Bold → Wild) for more spread. Push too far and prompt adherence degrades.

- *model_typesets the strength multipliers** —Krea2is 1.2× strength / 1.1× randomize against the Z-Image baseline. Across the full model table these span a 20× range, so the setting matters enormously on sensitive models; on Krea 2 the effect is mild.

- direction_shiftchanges thecharacterof the noise — each option has its own generator. The node also contains Krea2-specific 12-band shaping logic, but it is gated behind an embedding width divisible by 12; the Qwen3-VL encoder used here is 2560-wide, so that path never activates. The direction shifts still work, just without the band multipliers layered on top.

- cutoff_step / total_stepsare inert whilevariance_scheduleisconstant; they only matter for thehard_lock, step_cutoff, decreasingandtiered_releasemodes.

Docs:https://github.com/RamonGuthrie/ComfyUI-RBG-SmartSeedVariance

### Output and post-processing

1. **Node 17**VAEDecodeTiled— tiled decode (1024 tile / 128 overlap), kept because large decodes are memory-heavy on Macs. On a big-VRAM GPU a plainVAEDecodeis faster.

2. **Node 23**ColorCorrect— the post-processing stage. Temperature / hue / brightness / contrast / saturation / gamma, all currently **neutral**, so it's a pass-through until you dial something in. This is the place for a final grade rather than baking it into the prompt.

Docs:https://github.com/sipherxyz/comfyui-art-venture

3. **Node 19**Image Comparer (rgthree)— slider comparison, **A = colour-corrected**, **B = raw decode**, so you can see exactly what the grade did.

4. **Node 21**SaveImage— prefixKrea2/1. Note it is **not** in normal Always mode in this file, so a fresh import will not auto-save; set it to Always if you want every run written to disk.

## 3. Node 25 — Experimental Noise Injection

**Node 25ClownOptions_SDE_Betais an experiment.** It feeds anOPTIONSbundle into all three ClownsharKSamplers (nodes 22, 36 and 37), adding SDE-style noise on top of the sampler's owneta— churning noise back in during sampling to push texture and grain rather than letting the image resolve smoothly.

Current settings: gaussian noise type (step and substep),hardnoise mode,eta0.5 andeta_substep0.5, fixed seed.

**It is entirely optional.** Bypass itCtrl+B) and the workflow runs fine on the samplers' built-in settings — you'll get a cleaner, smoother result. Tweak it, mute it, or delete it as you see fit. Lower the etas for a subtler effect; raise them for more grit. Treat it as a texture dial, not a required part of the pipeline.

## Quick Start

1. Install the seven packages in the table above, restart ComfyUI.

2. Load the three models; confirm CLIPLoader type iskrea2.

3. Drop a reference image into node 31 (or bypass it for pure txt2img).

4. Write your prompt in node 30.

5. Set size in node 39.
